dedupe_keys.name: industrial ecology data commons iedc database and data model for material stocks flows lifetimes and process data

description: The Industrial Ecology Data Commons (IEDC) is a database and general data model for socioeconomic metabolism, the stocks and flows of materials and goods in society. Its data include stocks and flows of all kinds, composition data, prices, process inventories and product lifetimes, stored in a relational database with a common data model based on multidimensional arrays whose positions in time, region, process, commodity, material and scenario dimensions are recorded as tuples. Coverage: the datasets contributed so far, global and national, whose list was not read. The README describes the data as structured but not linked: datasets keep their own classifications, resolutions and scopes, placing the commons between general repositories such as Zenodo and fully integrated databases such as EXIOBASE. Format and access: a prototype database hosted at the University of Freiburg, plus the GitHub repository with MySQL code to create the database, CSV templates for lookup and classification tables, and Python scripts to write to and read from the database; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): set per dataset (IEDC records a licence for each dataset, from CC BY to all rights reserved); code MIT. Caveats: the prototype's availability and the number of datasets were not checked. Simulation uses: stocks, lifetimes and material composition of infrastructure and buildings for studies of material demand, ageing and replacement. Related records: EXIOBASE (data-exiobase) is the integrated input-output database it compares itself with.
